subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Which Feishu bind grammar should OpenClaw support before merging a fix for the Feishu accountId-vs-peer bug?
rationale: The current public CLI contract treats `<channel>:<value>` as an account binding, while Feishu conversation IDs need peer bindings and several open PRs choose different compatibility shapes; automation should not choose the permanent CLI grammar alone.

options.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer form
options.body: Keep `<channel>:<account>` behavior intact and add a documented peer/conversation syntax or narrowly recognized Feishu conversation-id path with compatibility tests.

options.title: Adopt Feishu id inference
options.body: Treat known Feishu conversation-id prefixes as peer bindings while preserving unknown values as account IDs, accepting a channel-specific parser rule.

options.title: Pause this branch for a sibling candidate
options.body: Close or pause this PR after choosing a better open candidate for the same canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer form
recommendation.body: Keep `<channel>:<account>` behavior intact and add a documented peer/conversation syntax or narrowly recognized Feishu conversation-id path with compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent docs and routing-helper history makes this the best available owner for the public CLI grammar and routing contract decision.
